hero.titleLead: The bank that keeps your money
hero.description: Open an account in 2 minutes, get your IBAN, make deposits and transfers, and track all your activity in real time.

features.title: Everything a modern bank should do
features.subtitle: A smooth, complete experience designed for your everyday life.

transfers.title: Instant transfers
transfers.desc: Send money to any IBAN, internally or externally, with a complete history.

card.title: Card & IBAN
card.desc: An IBAN is automatically assigned when you open your account, ready to receive and send.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.desc: Every deposit, transfer or change to your account triggers an instant notification.

deposits.title: One-click deposits
deposits.desc: Top up your account in seconds and watch your balance update in real time.

showcase.title: Manage your account at a glance
showcase.description: Real-time balance, filterable history, deposits, transfers and withdrawals — all in one clear, responsive space.
points: History filterable by type and status

items.title: Create your account
items.desc: Sign up in 2 minutes with an email. Your IBAN is generated automatically.

items.title: Fund your balance
items.desc: Add funds in one click from your dashboard.

items.title: Send & track
items.desc: Make transfers and withdrawals, get notifications, review your history.

security.title: Your data, in good hands
security.description: Encrypted authentication and secure sessions protect your account at all times.

items.quote: Finally an online bank that's simple and fast, without pointless paperwork.
